chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Anfield, December 2017, in the snow: Liverpool against Everton. Joe Gomez passes to Mohamed Salah on the right. He spins away... cuts inside... left foot... what a goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Salah starts wide on the right. He cuts inside, onto his stronger left foot, and suddenly the whole goal opens up.

chapters.label: Round the defender
chapters.text: He curls it around Ashley Williams, into the far top corner. Jordan Pickford can't reach it. It won the Puskás Award!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: cut inside onto your stronger foot, then curl it into the far corner.
